criteria.statement: The central docs service scans every Markdown file under docs/user-guide deterministically, exposes normalized topics/metadata, and rejects path traversal, duplicate topics, symlinked outside files, unsafe links, and missing targets explicitly.
MCP docs resources and bahia_docs_list/read use the central catalog with no static topic-list drift while preserving bahia://docs/{topic} resource compatibility and missing-topic errors.

The browser docs API is a read-only HTTP-native query surface mounted under /api/v1, returns catalog/document/link metadata, handles errors explicitly, rejects writes, and does not publish or claim Nostr command completion.

The web /docs UI browses grouped catalog topics, renders sanitized Markdown documents, rewrites internal links with central link-resolution data, preserves external links, and displays explicit catalog/read failure states.
Global navigation exposes a Docs entry and route-context docs affordances from nav-model docTopic metadata, and every referenced topic exists in the central catalog.

Assistant prompts keep the existing encrypted ContextVM assistant/prompt transport while sending visible, dismissible route documentation refs through selected_refs without dropping operational selected refs.

AssistantContextBuilder resolves docs:{topic} and bahia://docs/{topic} refs into bounded Documentation References context, records unresolved docs refs non-fatally, and preserves existing operational selected-ref resolution.

Cross-track closeout records PSTF artifacts, user-facing docs, route transport evidence, quality gates, Beads status, and confirms no fake catalog, placeholder UI, ignored API failure, hardcoded topic drift, or synthetic Nostr/ContextVM behavior remains in touched scope.
tests: cd web && npm test -- --run tests/unit/docs-ui.test.js tests/unit/nav.test.js tests/unit/assistant/assistant-components.test.js tests/unit/assistant/assistant-store.test.js tests/unit/route-transport-matrix.test.js
